strings.Kryostat раз в сутки переставляет дату о:
Once a day Kryostat moves the end date of the update pause forward, so Windows doesn't download updates or restart the computer at an inconvenient moment.

Windows allows pausing for at most 35 days. When the limit is reached, install the accumulated updates once — after that the countdown starts over and auto-extension keeps working.

It's better not to postpone security updates forever: they close the vulnerabilities that ransomware exploits.
